task: Phase 6 Step 6 -- Hirist block-classifier remediation, offline only, zero network requests

previous_false_positive_mechanism.old_behavior: checked _HARD_BLOCK_PHRASES/_CHALLENGE_PHRASES against html.lower() -- the entire raw HTML document, including <script> contents/attributes, <style> rules, HTML comments, and JSON-LD payload text
previous_false_positive_mechanism.confirmed_precedent: naukri_parser.py's own docstrings document a real prior incident: the literal word 'captcha' found inside a dormant .bot-guard-captcha CSS class on a genuinely valid Naukri page -- independently re-verified in Phase 6 Step 5 via grep against the real local fixture file

exact_remediation.before_code: lowered = html.lower(); for phrase in _HARD_BLOCK_PHRASES: if phrase in lowered: return ("BLOCKED", phrase); for phrase in _CHALLENGE_PHRASES: if phrase in lowered: return ("SOFT_BLOCK_OR_CHALLENGE", phrase); return (None, None)
exact_remediation.after_code: title, visible_text = _extract_visible_text(html); combined = f"{title} {visible_text}".lower(); for phrase in _HARD_BLOCK_PHRASES: if phrase in combined: return ("BLOCKED", phrase); for phrase in _CHALLENGE_PHRASES: if phrase in combined: return ("SOFT_BLOCK_OR_CHALLENGE", phrase); return (None, None)
exact_remediation.reuse_mechanism: plain Python import of naukri_parser._extract_visible_text() / _VisibleTextExtractor, used exactly as-is
exact_remediation.reuse_justification: the utility is genuinely source-agnostic (skips <script>/<style> content and never treats tag names/attributes as text) -- it knows nothing about Naukri's own page structure, so reusing it does not couple Hirist's parser to Naukri's

why_safer: structurally eliminates an entire class of false positive rather than trying to out-guess every noisy keyword in third-party scripts/CSS/JSON config
does not weaken genuine detection -- title and visible body text are both still checked exactly as before
reuses an already-proven, already-running-in-production mechanism (naukri_parser._VisibleTextExtractor) rather than inventing a new one
minimal blast radius: one function's internal implementation changed, one new read-only import, zero other files modified
